stroomuitval.intro: Many hotels keep a diesel generator for emergencies. But diesel generators are polluting, expensive to maintain and unreliable when you need them. Lemnion replaces your diesel generator with a battery system. Always on standby, without emissions.
stroomuitval.s1p: A diesel generator seems like a safe backup, until you need it. Diesel generators require regular maintenance, fuel ages, and during a prolonged power outage the supply can run out. A Lemnion battery system is the modern replacement: always charged, immediately available, and completely maintenance-free. No emissions, no noise, no hassle.
stroomuitval.c1p: With 261 kWh of LFP battery capacity, critical systems keep running during a grid outage: emergency lighting, lifts, cooling, reception systems. Guests notice nothing.
stroomuitval.c2p: In the event of a grid outage, the system switches to battery power within milliseconds. No start-up time like a diesel. The transition is seamless.
stroomuitval.c3p: No diesel, no CO2 emissions, no soot particles. A battery as backup power fits the sustainability goals of your hotel and lowers your environmental footprint.
stroomuitval.f1p: Maintenance needed, fuel ages, does not always start, emissions, noise nuisance, fuel tank checks.
stroomuitval.f2p: Always charged, millisecond switchover, zero maintenance, no emissions, completely silent, remotely monitorable.
stroomuitval.tip: Tip: A battery system is not just backup power | during the day it pays for itself through peak shaving and trading on the energy market.
stroomuitval.ctah: Ready to free your hotel from grid congestion?
stroomuitval.ctap: Calculate within 1 minute what your hotel can save with its own energy system.
